name_zh: 萨摩亚/法阿马泰/族群治理：法阿马泰共识与族群经济
name_en: Samoa/Fa'amatai/Clan Governance: Fa'amatai Consensus & Clan Economy
description_zh: 萨摩亚法阿马泰 — 族长制/马泰头衔/家族土地/村议会(福诺)/共识决策/互惠(法阿洛阿洛阿)/1962 独立/人权/性别/气候/移民/汇款/塔拉纳基/阿皮亚。核心治理模式：法阿马泰共识 — 马泰/福诺/家族/土地/教会/共识/互惠/服务/领导力即服务。体现 M205 法阿马泰共识 — 以"马泰头衔+福诺共识+家族土地+互惠服务"四位一体，在族群/教会/移民/气候四重现代压力下守护波利尼西亚族群治理。
description_en: Samoa Fa'amatai — matai titles/clan lands/village council (fono)/consensus decision/reciprocity (fa'aloalo)/1962 independence/human rights/gender/climate/migration/remittances/Taranaki/Apia. Core governance model: Fa'amatai consensus — matai/fono/clan/land/church/consensus/reciprocity/service/leadership as service. Exemplifies M205 Fa'amatai Consensus — quaternity of 'matai titles + fono consensus + clan lands + reciprocal service' guarding Polynesian clan governance amid quadruple modern pressures of clan/church/migration/climate.
reason_zh: 萨摩亚非单纯岛国，而是"马泰+福诺+家族土地"三位一体族群治理体。马泰头衔即领导力/服务/责任，福诺共识超越多数决，家族土地不可买卖/代际托管。M205 区隔于 M187 酋长制(加纳)、M203 万部落(巴新)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"马泰即服务+福诺即共识+土地即托管"的波利尼西亚族群治理范式。
reason_en: Samoa not mere island state but 'matai + fono + clan lands' trinity clan governance body. Matai title as leadership/service/responsibility, fono consensus transcends majority vote, clan lands inalienable/intergenerational trusteeship. M205 distinct from M187 Chiefship (Ghana), M203 Myriad Tribes (PNG), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'matai as service + fono as consensus + lands as trusteeship' Polynesian clan governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 马泰头衔即服务领导力：马泰/选举/服务/责任/福诺/家族/村庄/区域/国家/头衔不可买卖/服务即权威
福诺共识决策机制：村福诺/区福诺/国家福诺/长者/马泰/妇女/青年/共识/讨论/决定/服从/零投票
家族土地代际托管：习惯土地 80%+/家族/马泰/托管/不可买卖/租赁/开发/代际/生态/文化/主权
互惠服务与法阿洛阿洛阿：尊重/服务/礼物/宴会/葬礼/婚姻/建房/农业/互惠网络/社会保障/零国家福利
移民汇款与气候适应：10 万+ 侨民/汇款 30%+ GDP/新西兰/澳洲/美国/季节工/气候/海平面/村庄搬迁/适应基金
steps_en: Matai title as service leadership: matai/election/service/responsibility/fono/clan/village/district/national/titles inalienable/service = authority
Fono consensus mechanism: village fono/district fono/national fono/elders/matai/women/youth/consensus/deliberation/decision/compliance/zero voting
Clan lands intergenerational trusteeship: customary land 80%+/clan/matai/trusteeship/inalienable/lease/development/intergenerational/ecological/cultural/sovereign
Reciprocal service & fa'aloalo: respect/service/gifts/feasts/funerals/marriages/house-building/agriculture/reciprocal networks/social security/zero state welfare
Migration remittances & climate adaptation: 100k+ diaspora/remittances 30%+ GDP/NZ/AUS/US/seasonal workers/climate/sea level/village relocation/adaptation funds
expected_zh: 以"马泰服务+福诺共识+家族托管+互惠网络"四位一体，在族群/教会/移民/气候四重现代压力下守护波利尼西亚族群治理，为太平洋族群社会提供治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'matai service + fono consensus + clan trusteeship + reciprocal networks' guards Polynesian clan governance amid quadruple modern pressures of clan/church/migration/climate, providing governance paradigm for Pacific clan societies.
case_zh: 1962 独立/法阿马泰/福诺/家族土地/移民汇款/气候适应/人权/性别/教会/族群治理存续，波利尼西亚治理活化石。
case_en: 1962 independence/Fa'amatai/fono/clan lands/migration remittances/climate adaptation/human rights/gender/church/clan governance endures, Polynesian governance living fossil.
